name: Video Render
intro: Video Render is the SmartVideo studio for finishing a video you already made. Pick a clip, choose a look, set your output, and export a polished version without building a timeline.

features.choosing-a-video: Start by choosing a video from the grid. Click a card to load it, and the header shows its title. Render always works on videos that already exist in your library.
features.presets: Presets set the finishing style. Choose Luxury Brand Grade, Documentary Contrast, Film Trailer Punch or Emotional Story Tone, and you see its color profile and pacing right away.
features.output-settings: Output settings control file type and size. Pick a format your browser can encode, choose twenty four, thirty or sixty frames per second, and drag the quality slider.
features.export-video: Export Video is the main button. It runs the export in your browser, shows progress, and checks the file when it finishes, so you know you have a finished video.
features.queue-render: Queue Render adds a job to the render queue instead of exporting right now. It's handy when you want to line up several exports and download each one when it's done.
features.download-frame: Download Frame saves the current frame as a PNG. Use it when you need a quick thumbnail or a still image from your video.
features.trailer-cut-social-resize-remix-scene: Trailer Cut builds a shorter trailer style export. Social Resize makes versions for nine by sixteen, square, four by five and sixteen by nine, so one video fits every platform.
features.drafts-templates-and-saved-items: Save Draft stores your current setup, and Save as Template keeps it for later. The Saved button opens your list, so you can reuse settings you already like.

outro: That's the quick tour of Video Render. Choose a video, pick a look, and export the version you need. Start with a short test export to check your settings.
